title: Readiculous Readers: Complete Bundle (Stages 1, 2 & 3) | Mrs Wordsmith
meta_description: The complete Readiculous journey — all three stages of laughter-led, science-backed decodable readers in one bundle. 36 books for ages 4–7. Aligned to the Science of Reading.
heading: Readiculous Readers: Complete Bundle (Stages 1, 2 & 3)

description.html:
Give your child every laugh-out-loud lesson they need to become a confident, independent reader. The Complete Readiculous Readers Bundle brings together all three stages of our laughter-led, science-backed decodable readers into one unmissable collection — taking children from first sounds to fluent, joke-cracking storytelling, all fully aligned to Systematic Synthetic Phonics teaching used in schools across the UK and US.

Learning Goals

  • Master phonics from first sounds right through to advanced spelling patterns, in one seamless set.
  • Build the decoding skills and confidence needed for the tests your child faces in school (e.g. Year 1 Phonics Screening Check).
  • Progress systematically from vowel digraphs and consonant blends (Stage 1), through common digraphs and early trigraphs (Stage 2), to split digraphs and advanced spelling patterns (Stage 3).
  • Reinforce every sound learned along the way through carefully sequenced repetition.
  • Turn "I can't read that" into "let me at it" with stories kids actually want to finish.


What's Inside

  • All 3 stages of Readiculous Readers — 36 expertly sequenced, fully decodable paperback books in total.
  • Stage 1 (12 books): introduces vowel digraphs and consonant blends.
  • Stage 2 (12 books): builds fluency with common digraphs (qu, th, sh, ch, igh, oa, ee) and early trigraphs (ear, air).
  • Stage 3 (12 books): tackles advanced spelling patterns (ay, ie, wh) and split digraphs (a-e, i-e).
  • Hilarious stories starring Mrs Wordsmith's much-loved cast of characters throughout.
  • One complete phonics journey, so there's no guessing what to buy next.


How It Works

  • Each stage introduces new phonics patterns in context, through fully decodable words and sentences.
  • Previously taught sounds are revisited and reinforced throughout, so nothing is forgotten.
  • Stories grow gradually longer and richer across all three stages, building comprehension alongside decoding.
  • Children move from sounding out single words to reading whole, funny stories independently — at their own pace.


Why It Works

  • Systematic Synthetic Phonics: aligned with the Science of Reading and the phonics approach used across UK primary schools, so learning at home matches learning at school.
  • Built for the Phonics Screening Check: the sounds and patterns taught across all three stages map onto what children need for the Year 1 statutory check.
  • Confidence Building: children decode increasingly complex words independently, boosting self-esteem with every page turn.
  • Engaging Storytelling: funny, surprising plots (and Mrs Wordsmith's famously ridiculous characters) keep children turning pages long after bedtime should have started.
  • Expertly Crafted: developed with education experts to match your child's needs.

 

Specifications

  • Format: 3 sets of 12 paperback readers (36 books total)
  • Age range: 4–7 years (Reception to Year 2)
  • Curriculum alignment: Systematic Synthetic Phonics
  • Dimensions: each box measures 14.5cm x 17.5cm

 

Who It's For

  • Parents wanting one complete phonics library that grows with their child.
  • Teachers and TAs looking for decodable readers to use across a full phonics programme.
  • Home educators after a structured, ready-made reading curriculum.
  • Grandparents and gift-givers after one big, brilliant present.

Learning to read takes repetition — so we've made ridiculously fun the whole way through.
